# Vendor JavaScript for static Markdown viewer

This directory vendors browser-side dependencies used by `markdown.html` so the Insight static site does not depend on external CDNs.

- `marked.umd.js` from npm package `marked` 18.0.5
- `purify.min.js` from npm package `dompurify` 3.4.11

Licenses are kept next to the vendored files.
